October - November
Spring term deadlines begin. International graduate applicants: October 14. International undergraduate applicants and graduate programs with rolling admissions: November 1.
December - January
Domestic undergraduate fall priority scholarship deadline: December 15 (Meeting the priority deadline means your application can be considered for scholarships and grants). Domestic undergraduate spring application deadline: January 2.
March - April
Summer term deadlines begin. International graduate applicants: March 10. Graduate fall scholarship consideration closes: March 15. International undergraduate applicants: April 1. Domestic undergraduate summer priority scholarship deadline: April 15.
May - June
International graduate fall deadline: May 19. Domestic undergraduate summer application deadline: May 28. International undergraduate fall deadline: June 1.
International student resources
International student resources
July - August
Graduate fall rolling admissions open from July 1; each program sets its own deadline. Domestic undergraduate fall application deadline: August 7.

No test scores?
We admit in-state freshmen with a 2.5+ core GPA on the Louisiana Core 4 without test scores. You'll complete an Accuplacer exam for English and Math placement.
View program

How to apply in four steps
01
Set up your profile
Visit the application portal and create your account with your email and password. You'll use this to track your application status throughout the process.
Create account
02
Submit documents
Gather your official high school or college transcripts and submit them to the LSU New Orleans Office of Admissions. If you are including test scores, request official reports directly from the testing agency.
Submit documents
03
Complete application
Fill out all sections of your application, including academic history and intended program. Review your information carefully before submitting.
Complete application
04
Submit and wait
Submit your completed application and watch for a confirmation email. Your admissions decision will arrive at the email address on file, typically within a few weeks of receiving all required materials.

What are LSU New Orleans's academic calendar dates and important deadlines?
The academic calendar covers key dates for each term — including the first and last days of class, registration periods, holidays, final exam schedules, and census dates. Check the calendar to plan your semester from start to finish.
What scholarships and financial aid does LSU New Orleans offer?
LSU New Orleans offers merit-based institutional scholarships for incoming students, federal and state aid including TOPS, and graduate funding options. All students are encouraged to complete the FAFSA each year. Scholarship availability and award amounts are not changing as a result of the transition.
How do I apply to LSU New Orleans? What are the admissions requirements?
Apply online, send official transcripts, and check your status through the admissions portal. All domestic undergraduate application fees are currently waived. Requirements vary by program, and the admissions team is available to guide you through every step.
What are LSU New Orleans's summer class options and schedule?
Summer 2026 offers both full-term and accelerated session options. The full term runs June 8 through July 29, with additional four-week sessions available. Check the academic calendar for registration dates, add/drop deadlines, and the full summer schedule.
